name: Blind-Spot Cross-Validation
aliases: Blind-spot cross-validation for Gaussian splat model selection
definition: A technique to set the splat budget (number of Gaussians) without noise-free references by using a held-out dataset to determine the point of diminishing returns where added splats begin to memorize noise.
summary: Blind-Spot Cross-Validation selects the optimal Gaussian splat count by masking voxels and monitoring held-out PSNR divergence to prevent noise memorization without ground truth.
